findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: whoami, example · Private data: whoami, example, lookup_crawler, changes_since · Public sink: whoami, example, is_verified_crawler_ip, changes_since · Destructive: whoami, example.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: whoami, example · Private data: whoami, example, lookup_crawler, changes_since · Public sink: whoami, example, is_verified_crawler_ip, changes_since · Destructive: whoami, example

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
